title: Beautiful!!
text: Beautiful!!. This piece is beautiful and sturdy! The storage is roomy enough to fit blankets and various other items. The assembly was easy and I had no issues. I fell in love with this piece so much that I bought the matching TV stand and couch end table!

product_metadata.title: Signature Design by Ashley Wystfield Farmhouse Square Storage Coffee Table with Hinged Lift Top, Distressed White & Wystfield Farmhouse End Table with Storage, Distressed White & Brown Finish
features: Product 1: SPACIOUS SURFACE: Measuring 36" W x 36" D x 18" H, this cocktail table looks great set in both small and large living room spaces
Product 1: HANDSOMELY CRAFTED: Table is made of veneers, wood and engineered wood in a distressed finish. Designed with metal bracket, hardware and a 2 sided hinged lift top (with stay arms)
Product 1: RUSTIC APPEAL: Between the plank effect styling, industrial bracket hardware and two-tone finish, this modern table amplifies farmhouse in your home with a punch of personality
Product 1: STORAGE COFFEE TABLE: The spacious storage compartment makes this table the perfect embodiment of beauty and practicality. Distressed with a reclaimed look, it'll entice everyone
Product 2: CASUAL END TABLE: The storage space makes this side table the perfect embodiment of beauty and practicality in your home. Distressed with a reclaimed look, it'll entice everyone
Product 2: HANDSOMELY CRAFTED: Table is made of veneers, wood and engineered wood in a distressed finish. Designed with a double door cabinet with metal grills and hardware and a center shelf

Product 2: RUSTIC APPEAL: Between the plank effect styling, visible shelf storage through the metal grills and two-tone finish, this modern table amplifies farmhouse in your home paired with a plant or lamp
Product 2: SMALL SPACE SOLUTION: Measuring 24" W x 26" D x 27" H, this table looks great set by a living room sofa or in narrow spaces such as an entryway or hallway
description: Signature Design by Ashley Wystfield Farmhouse Square Storage Coffee Table with Hinged Lift Top, Distressed WhiteDouble take. Sporting a two-tone finish, dual-sided lid design and expansive storage space, this square coffee table takes the art of rustic farmhouse living to a new level. Designer touches include plank-effect styling, heavy distressing and industrial bracket hardware.Signature Design by Ashley Wystfield Farmhouse End Table with Storage, Distressed White & Brown FinishDouble take. Sporting a two-tone finish that pairs a distressed vintage white with aged natural pine color, this end table elevates the art of rustic farmhouse living. Enhancing its charm: shelved storage visible through cabinet doors with inset metal grills.
